title: Filling the Bird Feeders

readiness.math: estimating amounts; filling to a line; half and quarter (older)

intro.speaker: ruth
intro.text: Listen to the birds singing! In the grove, I hang feeders for them. Today they're empty.

intro.speaker: ruth
intro.text: Pour the seed into each feeder, and stop at the line. Too much and it spills on the ground.

steps.speaker: ruth
steps.prompt: Fill each feeder to its line. Hold the jug of seed over a feeder, and let go at the line.

older.prompt: Fill each feeder to its line: half, full, and a quarter.

feedback.too_full: Oops, that one is too full: the seed is over the line. Tap it to pour it back.
feedback.all_good: Every feeder is full to its line. The birds will feast!

outro.speaker: ruth
outro.text: Look at the birds, they're coming already! Jesus said, "Look at the birds: they don't sow or reap, and your Father feeds them."

outro.speaker: ruth
outro.text: Today, He used your hands to do it.

journal_line: I filled the bird feeders in the grove with Mrs. Ruth, and the birds came to eat.
unavailable_text: The feeders are full for today. Listen to the birds!
